intent: A pure vertical ladder from the orchard floor to the high overlook: 96-pixel riser posts over bramble beds, switchback retaining walls that nearly touch the sky, and falling fruit to read on the way.

sections.name: The orchard floor
sections.lesson: Climb the fallen-fruit ladder — every rise is a full jump

signs.text:
The orchard floor
Climb the ladder; the brambles below are hungry

sections.name: The fruit-tree terraces
sections.lesson: Rise between the planted terraces; mind the falling fruit

signs.text:
The fruit-tree terraces
Full jumps only — the beds below are thorns

sections.name: Among the high branches
sections.lesson: Switchback up the high branches as fruit drops past

signs.text:
Among the high branches
Watch the fruit fall before you commit

sections.name: The retaining walls
sections.lesson: Scale the retaining wall to the sky, then thread the drop ledges

signs.text:
The retaining walls
Nineteen rises up, nine ledges down — no pause

sections.name: The high orchard overlook
sections.lesson: Crouch-run the pruned corridor, then drop to the overlook

signs.text:
The high orchard overlook
Short hops only — the canopy is thorned
